title: H. G. Wells: The War of the Worlds — Ep 17/27 — "The Thunder Child"
description:
The War of the Worlds, Episode 17. London empties into a human torrent, the black vapour spreads across road and rail, and George drives the two Elphinstone women east toward the one door still open: the sea.

At the Pool of London escape turns to fighting among the jammed boats. Out on the Essex marsh, past plundered Tillingham, the coast opens on a fleet of every kind of vessel — and Mrs. Elphinstone would rather die than trust herself friendless in a foreign country. Thirty-six pounds buys the three of them passage on a crowded paddle steamer.

Then three Martian fighting-machines wade out into the sea to cut the fleet off, and the torpedo ram Thunder Child comes tearing between them at full speed, her guns silent until the last moment. Gas, Heat-Ray, steam and naval fire turn the water into a battlefield. "Two!" yells the captain — and the fleet scatters into the evening haze while something vast rises over the darkening land.

Chapter XVII of Book One of H. G. Wells's The War of the Worlds (1898), "The 'Thunder Child'", in the public domain.

— The Keeper's Lantern —
Every episode is one whole chapter, in order, from the first page to the last.
